question: Should the audio-capable `DEFAULT_AUDIO_FORMAT` constraints become the shared transcription default, or be scoped to Loom until compatibility across existing yt-dlp hosts is demonstrated?
rationale: The selector is logically appropriate for audio transcription, but this PR's live proof and focused tests cover Loom rather than the full set of existing media hosts that share this setting.

options.title: Keep the shared selector
options.body: Accept the stricter audio-capable format chain for all yt-dlp transcription because selecting a video-only fallback cannot produce a valid transcript.

options.title: Scope it to Loom
options.body: Preserve the established selector for other hosts and apply the stricter chain only to Loom until broader extractor compatibility is verified.

recommendation.title: Keep the shared selector
recommendation.body: Accept the stricter audio-capable format chain for all yt-dlp transcription because selecting a video-only fallback cannot produce a valid transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects him to the shared yt-dlp format policy and the surrounding transcript pipeline.
